gaps.title: No A* pathfinding algorithm
gaps.description: A* is the standard heuristic search for grid/graph pathfinding. Essential for obstacle avoidance in agricultural fields with trees, rocks, buildings. Current CoveragePlanner only supports boustrophedon on rectangular bounding boxes.
gaps.impact: Cannot plan paths around obstacles; limited to simple rectangular fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement A* with configurable heuristics (Manhattan, Euclidean, Chebyshev) for grid-based field representation

gaps.title: No RRT/RRT* algorithm
gaps.description: Rapidly-exploring Random Trees are essential for high-dimensional path planning and non-holonomic vehicle constraints (e.g., minimum turning radius for tractors).
gaps.impact: Cannot handle vehicle kinematic constraints or complex obstacle fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement RRT and RRT* with steering models for agricultural vehicles

gaps.title: No Dijkstra's algorithm
gaps.description: Dijkstra's is the baseline for shortest-path computation without heuristics. Needed as fallback when no heuristic is available.
gaps.impact: No guaranteed optimal path without A* heuristic
gaps.recommendation: Implement Dijkstra as baseline shortest-path algorithm

gaps.title: No D* (Dynamic A*) algorithm
gaps.description: D* is essential for dynamic replanning when obstacles are discovered during execution (e.g., newly detected rocks, animals, or other drones).
gaps.impact: Cannot replan paths when environment changes during execution
gaps.recommendation: Implement D* Lite for efficient incremental replanning

gaps.title: No PRM (Probabilistic Roadmap)
gaps.description: PRM is useful for pre-computing roadmaps in complex environments that can be reused for multiple queries.
gaps.impact: Repeated planning in same field is inefficient
gaps.recommendation: Implement PRM for multi-query path planning scenarios

gaps.title: No wavefront algorithm
gaps.description: Wavefront (brushfire) algorithm is simple and effective for grid-based coverage with obstacles.
gaps.impact: No alternative coverage pattern for obstacle-rich environments
gaps.recommendation: Implement wavefront propagation for obstacle-aware coverage

gaps.title: No spiral coverage pattern
gaps.description: Spiral pattern is useful for circular or irregular fields and for center-out or center-in coverage strategies.
gaps.impact: Cannot efficiently cover circular/irregular fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement spiral coverage for non-rectangular fields

gaps.title: No zigzag/diagonal coverage pattern
gaps.description: Diagonal patterns can reduce total path length for certain field shapes.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal path length for some field geometries
gaps.recommendation: Implement diagonal boustrophedon as alternative pattern

gaps.title: No obstacle avoidance in coverage planner
gaps.description: Current implementation assumes rectangular fields with no obstacles. Real agricultural fields have trees, rocks, power lines, buildings, and other hazards. The boustrophedon pattern generates straight lines across the bounding box without checking obstacle intersections.
gaps.impact: Paths may collide with obstacles; unsafe for real-world deployment
gaps.recommendation: Add obstacle representation and integrate with A*/RRT for obstacle-aware planning

gaps.title: No non-convex field support
gaps.description: Current implementation uses bounding box (lines 66-69) which over-covers for L-shaped, T-shaped, or irregular fields, leading to wasted time and resources. The coverage_ratio calculation (line 96-98) uses bounding box area, not actual polygon area.
gaps.impact: Wasted coverage area and resources on non-convex fields
gaps.recommendation: Implement polygon clipping and decomposition for non-convex fields

gaps.title: No multi-field support
gaps.description: Agricultural operations often span multiple adjacent or separate fields. Current implementation handles one field at a time.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize routes across multiple fields
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-field planning with inter-field transit optimization

gaps.title: No terrain/elevation consideration
gaps.description: Agricultural fields have slopes and elevation changes that affect vehicle speed, energy consumption, and safety.
gaps.impact: Inaccurate time/energy estimates; potential safety issues on steep slopes
gaps.recommendation: Add DEM (Digital Elevation Model) integration for terrain-aware planning

gaps.title: No energy/battery constraints
gaps.description: Drones and electric vehicles have limited battery life. Current implementation doesn't consider energy consumption or range limits.
gaps.impact: Planned paths may exceed vehicle range; no recharge stop planning
gaps.recommendation: Add energy model and recharge/refuel stop insertion

gaps.title: No wind/weather consideration
gaps.description: Wind affects drone flight time, spray drift, and energy consumption. Current implementation ignores weather.
gaps.impact: Inaccurate time estimates; unsafe operations in high wind
gaps.recommendation: Add weather data integration for wind-aware planning

gaps.title: No dynamic replanning
gaps.description: When obstacles are discovered or conditions change during execution, the path cannot be updated.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing conditions during execution
gaps.recommendation: Implement D* Lite or similar incremental replanning

gaps.title: No path smoothing
gaps.description: Boustrophedon paths have sharp 180-degree turns at field edges. Smoothing reduces wear and energy consumption.
gaps.impact: Increased vehicle wear and energy consumption
gaps.recommendation: Add path smoothing with curvature constraints (e.g., Dubins paths)

gaps.title: No partial coverage support
gaps.description: Sometimes only a portion of the field needs coverage (e.g., pest hotspots, nutrient-deficient zones).
gaps.impact: Cannot perform targeted/precision coverage
gaps.recommendation: Add support for partial field coverage with priority zones

gaps.title: No no-fly zone support
gaps.description: Regulatory no-fly zones (airports, military bases, populated areas) must be avoided.
gaps.impact: Potential regulatory violations
gaps.recommendation: Add geofencing with no-fly zone polygons

gaps.title: No headland turn optimization
gaps.description: Headland turns at field edges are time-consuming. Different turn patterns (loop, skip, U-turn) have different efficiencies.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal turn patterns waste time
gaps.recommendation: Add headland turn pattern selection and optimization

gaps.title: No variable rate application support
gaps.description: Precision agriculture requires varying application rates based on soil/pest maps. Current implementation assumes uniform coverage.
gaps.impact: Cannot support variable rate application
gaps.recommendation: Add VRA (Variable Rate Application) map integration

gaps.title: No multi-drone coverage coordination
gaps.description: Multiple drones covering the same field need coordinated paths to avoid collisions and ensure complete coverage.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale to multi-drone operations
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-agent coverage with collision avoidance and task decomposition

gaps.title: No path execution monitoring
gaps.description: No mechanism to detect if the vehicle deviates from the planned path or if execution fails.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect or recover from path execution failures
gaps.recommendation: Add path tracking with deviation detection and recovery

gaps.title: No large field decomposition
gaps.description: Very large fields may need to be decomposed into sub-fields for memory and computation efficiency.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation on very large fields
gaps.recommendation: Add field decomposition with hierarchical planning

gaps.title: No GPS waypoint export
gaps.description: Paths need to be exported in standard formats (GPX, GeoJSON, KML) for drone flight controllers.
gaps.impact: Cannot directly use paths with commercial drone systems
gaps.recommendation: Add export to GPX, GeoJSON, and KML formats

gaps.title: No 3D terrain following
gaps.description: Drones may need to follow terrain at constant altitude above ground level.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain constant AGL altitude over varying terrain
gaps.recommendation: Add terrain-following altitude profile generation

gaps.title: Coverage ratio calculation is inaccurate
gaps.description: The coverage_ratio (line 96-98) uses bounding box area instead of actual polygon area. For non-rectangular fields, this overestimates coverage. Also, covered_area = num_passes * swath * (max_x - min_x) doesn't account for the actual field shape.
gaps.impact: Misleading coverage metrics for non-rectangular fields
gaps.recommendation: Use polygon area (shoelace formula) for accurate coverage ratio

gaps.title: Start point not used in path generation
gaps.description: The start_point field in CoverageInstance is validated but never used in _boustrophedon(). The path always starts at (min_x, min_y) regardless of start_point.
gaps.impact: Cannot start coverage from a specific location (e.g., nearest to depot)
gaps.recommendation: Use start_point to determine initial pass direction and starting corner

gaps.title: No path direction optimization
gaps.description: The boustrophedon always starts in Y direction. For elongated fields, X-direction passes may be shorter.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal path length for elongated fields
gaps.recommendation: Auto-select pass direction based on field aspect ratio

gaps.title: No polygon obstacle support
gaps.description: ObstacleField only supports circular obstacles (cx, cy, r). Real obstacles like buildings, ponds, tree lines, and rock formations are better represented as polygons.
gaps.impact: Cannot represent most real-world obstacle shapes
gaps.recommendation: Add polygon obstacle representation with point-in-polygon and line-polygon intersection tests

gaps.title: No line-obstacle intersection test
gaps.description: The module can check if a point is inside an obstacle but cannot check if a line segment intersects an obstacle. This is essential for path validation.
gaps.impact: Cannot validate if a planned path crosses an obstacle
gaps.recommendation: Add line_segment_intersects_obstacle() for path validation

gaps.title: No tangent-based detour algorithm
gaps.description: The avoid_path() method (line 22-31) generates a square detour around the obstacle, which is inefficient. Tangent-based detours produce shorter paths.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal detour paths increase travel distance
gaps.recommendation: Implement tangent-based detour waypoint generation

gaps.title: No obstacle merging
gaps.description: Overlapping obstacles are treated as separate entities. This can cause redundant detours and inefficient paths.
gaps.impact: Redundant detours around overlapping obstacles
gaps.recommendation: Add obstacle merging for overlapping circles

gaps.title: No dynamic obstacle addition/removal
gaps.description: Obstacles are set at initialization and cannot be modified during execution. Real scenarios require adding obstacles discovered during operation.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to newly discovered obstacles
gaps.recommendation: Add add_obstacle() and remove_obstacle() methods

gaps.title: No safety buffer configuration
gaps.description: The safety buffer is hardcoded to 1.0 (line 30: b = r + 1.0). Different vehicles and scenarios need different safety margins.
gaps.impact: Cannot configure safety margins for different vehicle types
gaps.recommendation: Make safety buffer configurable per obstacle or per field

gaps.title: No obstacle field serialization
gaps.description: No way to save/load obstacle fields to/from disk. Fields need to be redefined each time.
gaps.impact: Cannot persist obstacle configurations
gaps.recommendation: Add JSON/GeoJSON serialization for obstacle fields

gaps.title: No spatial indexing for obstacles
gaps.description: is_obstacle() iterates through all obstacles (O(n)). For large obstacle fields, this is slow.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation with many obstacles
gaps.recommendation: Add spatial indexing (quadtree, R-tree, or grid-based) for efficient obstacle lookup

gaps.title: No obstacle validation
gaps.description: No validation for negative radius, NaN coordinates, or degenerate obstacles.
gaps.impact: Invalid obstacles can cause incorrect behavior
gaps.recommendation: Add obstacle validation in constructor and add_obstacle()

gaps.title: No task reassignment on agent failure
gaps.description: When an agent is marked as FAILED (line 139), its assigned tasks remain in ASSIGNED state forever. No mechanism reassigns those tasks to other agents. The check_health() method only marks agents as failed but does not trigger task recovery.
gaps.impact: Tasks assigned to failed agents are lost; swarm cannot recover from agent failures
gaps.recommendation: Add task reassignment logic in check_health() that detects failed agents and reassigns their tasks to active agents

gaps.title: No leader election integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator has no mechanism to elect a leader agent for coordination decisions. All agents are peers with no hierarchy. The LeaderElection class exists in fault_tolerance.py but is not integrated.
gaps.impact: No single point of coordination; potential for conflicting decisions
gaps.recommendation: Integrate LeaderElection into SwarmCoordinator for coordinated decision-making

gaps.title: No collision avoidance integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with CollisionAvoidance. Agents can be assigned overlapping tasks without spatial separation checks.
gaps.impact: Physical collisions between agents possible
gaps.recommendation: Integrate CollisionAvoidance into task assignment to prevent spatial conflicts

gaps.title: No formation flying
gaps.description: No support for agents maintaining specific geometric formations during movement.
gaps.impact: Cannot execute formation-based operations (e.g., coordinated spraying)
gaps.recommendation: Add formation control with configurable patterns

gaps.title: No task preemption
gaps.description: No mechanism to preempt lower-priority tasks when higher-priority tasks arrive. Tasks have no priority field.
gaps.impact: Cannot respond to urgent tasks promptly
gaps.recommendation: Add priority-based task preemption

gaps.title: No priority-based task scheduling
gaps.description: Tasks have no priority field. All tasks are treated equally regardless of urgency.
gaps.impact: Cannot prioritize critical tasks (e.g., pest outbreak response)
gaps.recommendation: Add task priority field and priority-aware scheduling

gaps.title: No deadline-aware scheduling
gaps.description: Tasks have no deadlines. Cannot ensure time-critical tasks complete on time.
gaps.impact: Cannot guarantee task completion within time constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task deadlines and deadline-aware scheduling

gaps.title: No resource constraints
gaps.description: Agents have no resource limits (battery, payload, fuel). Tasks have no resource requirements. The _find_best_agent method (line 208-234) only considers task count for load balancing.
gaps.impact: Can over-assign tasks beyond agent capacity
gaps.recommendation: Add resource model with capacity constraints

gaps.title: No communication constraints
gaps.description: No model of communication range or bandwidth limitations between agents.
gaps.impact: Cannot plan for communication-limited environments
gaps.recommendation: Add communication range model and constraint-aware task assignment

gaps.title: No task dependencies
gaps.description: Tasks cannot depend on other tasks. Cannot model workflows where task B requires task A to complete first.
gaps.impact: Cannot model complex multi-step operations
gaps.recommendation: Add task dependency graph with topological ordering

gaps.title: No task decomposition
gaps.description: No mechanism to decompose complex tasks into subtasks.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle complex multi-step tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add task decomposition with subtask management

gaps.title: No agent recovery mechanism
gaps.description: Failed agents are permanently marked as FAILED (line 139). No mechanism to recover or restart agents. Once failed, an agent can never return to service.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from transient failures
gaps.recommendation: Add agent recovery with state reset and task reassignment

gaps.title: No task retry mechanism
gaps.description: Failed tasks cannot be retried. No retry count or backoff strategy. Tasks have no retry counter.
gaps.impact: Transient task failures are permanent
gaps.recommendation: Add task retry with configurable max retries and exponential backoff

gaps.title: No distributed coordination
gaps.description: All coordination is centralized in a single SwarmCoordinator instance. No support for distributed coordination across multiple coordinators. All state is in Python dicts (line 67-68).
gaps.impact: Single point of failure; cannot scale to large swarms
gaps.recommendation: Add distributed coordination with coordinator replication

gaps.title: No agent capacity limits
gaps.description: No limit on how many tasks can be assigned to a single agent. The load balancing in _find_best_agent (line 228-233) only considers current assignment count, not a maximum capacity.
gaps.impact: Can overload agents with too many tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add max tasks per agent limit

gaps.title: No consensus integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with ByzantineConsensus for coordinated decision-making. The consensus module exists but is completely independent.
gaps.impact: Cannot make Byzantine-fault-tolerant collective decisions
gaps.recommendation: Integrate consensus module for collective decision-making

gaps.title: No task allocation integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with TaskAllocator for optimal task assignment. Uses simple greedy matching (_find_best_agent) instead of optimal allocation.
gaps.impact: Uses simple greedy matching instead of optimal allocation
gaps.recommendation: Integrate TaskAllocator for optimal task-to-agent assignment

gaps.title: No path planning integration
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator does not integrate with CoveragePlanner for path planning. Agents are assigned tasks but have no planned routes.
gaps.impact: Cannot plan paths for agents to reach task locations
gaps.recommendation: Integrate path planning for agent routing

gaps.title: No heartbeat authentication
gaps.description: Heartbeats are not authenticated. Any process can send heartbeats for any agent (line 114-126). No verification that the heartbeat comes from the claimed agent.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerability; potential for spoofed heartbeats
gaps.recommendation: Add heartbeat authentication with agent credentials

gaps.title: No metrics collection
gaps.description: No metrics on task completion time, agent utilization, swarm throughput, etc. Only logging is present.
gaps.impact: Cannot monitor or optimize swarm performance
gaps.recommendation: Add metrics collection and reporting

gaps.title: No task completion reporting
gaps.description: Tasks can be assigned but there is no method to mark a task as completed. The TaskStatus enum has COMPLETED but no code path sets it.
gaps.impact: Cannot track task progress or completion
gaps.recommendation: Add complete_task() method and task progress tracking

gaps.title: No task failure reporting
gaps.description: Tasks can be assigned but there is no method to mark a task as failed. The TaskStatus enum has FAILED but no code path sets it.
gaps.impact: Cannot track task failures or trigger retries
gaps.recommendation: Add fail_task() method with automatic retry logic

gaps.title: No agent status recovery
gaps.description: AgentStatus enum has ACTIVE, FAILED, BUSY but no method to transition from FAILED back to ACTIVE or from BUSY to ACTIVE.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover agents or track busy state transitions
gaps.recommendation: Add set_agent_status() method with valid state transitions

gaps.title: No swarm topology awareness
gaps.description: No concept of agent positions or spatial relationships. Agents are abstract IDs with capabilities but no locations.
gaps.impact: Cannot make spatially-aware task assignments
gaps.recommendation: Add agent position tracking and spatial assignment constraints

gaps.title: No actual PBFT implementation
gaps.description: The consensus module is a simulation, not a real PBFT implementation. The propose() method (line 72-101) only returns PENDING for multi-node systems without any actual message exchange. No pre-prepare, prepare, or commit phases exist.
gaps.impact: Cannot be used for real distributed consensus; only useful for testing
gaps.recommendation: Implement full PBFT with pre-prepare, prepare, and commit phases

gaps.title: No message passing layer
gaps.description: No network layer for sending and receiving consensus messages between nodes. The module is entirely local with no I/O.
gaps.impact: Cannot communicate with other nodes in a real deployment
gaps.recommendation: Add network layer with message serialization and transport

gaps.title: No view change protocol
gaps.description: PBFT requires a view change protocol to handle primary node failure. Not implemented. No concept of views or view numbers.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from primary node failure
gaps.recommendation: Implement view change protocol for primary failure recovery

gaps.title: No checkpointing
gaps.description: No checkpointing mechanism for log compaction and state transfer. No concept of stable checkpoints.
gaps.impact: Log grows unboundedly; new nodes cannot catch up efficiently
gaps.recommendation: Add checkpointing with state transfer for new nodes

gaps.title: No log replication
gaps.description: No replicated log for consensus decisions. Only single-value voting is supported. No log entries or sequencing.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain consistent state across nodes
gaps.recommendation: Add replicated log with log entry sequencing

gaps.title: No leader election
gaps.description: No mechanism to elect or change the primary/leader node. The node_id is fixed at initialization.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle leader failure or dynamic membership
gaps.recommendation: Implement leader election integrated with view change

gaps.title: No client request handling
gaps.description: No mechanism for clients to submit requests to the consensus system. The propose() method is called directly with no request queuing.
gaps.impact: Cannot accept external requests for consensus
gaps.recommendation: Add client request API with request queuing

gaps.title: No state machine replication
gaps.description: No replicated state machine for executing consensus decisions. Consensus results are returned but not applied to any state machine.
gaps.impact: Cannot maintain consistent application state across nodes
gaps.recommendation: Add state machine replication layer

gaps.title: No cryptographic signatures
gaps.description: No message authentication or integrity verification. Votes and proposals are not signed. Any node can forge votes.
gaps.impact: Vulnerable to message tampering and spoofing
gaps.recommendation: Add cryptographic signatures for all consensus messages

gaps.title: No timeout handling
gaps.description: No timeout for consensus rounds. If nodes don't respond, consensus hangs indefinitely. The propose() method returns PENDING with no timeout.
gaps.impact: Consensus can stall indefinitely
gaps.recommendation: Add consensus timeouts with automatic retry or view change

gaps.title: No recovery mechanism
gaps.description: No mechanism for nodes to recover and rejoin the consensus after failure. No state catch-up protocol.
gaps.impact: Failed nodes cannot rejoin; system degrades over time
gaps.recommendation: Add node recovery with state catch-up

gaps.title: No dynamic membership
gaps.description: Total node count is fixed at initialization (line 51). Cannot add or remove nodes at runtime. No reconfiguration protocol.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale swarm membership dynamically
gaps.recommendation: Add dynamic membership with reconfiguration protocol

gaps.title: No vote deduplication
gaps.description: tally_votes() (line 103-147) counts duplicate votes from the same node. No deduplication by node ID. A single node can vote multiple times to reach quorum.
gaps.impact: A single node can vote multiple times to reach quorum
gaps.recommendation: Add vote deduplication by node ID

gaps.title: No tie-breaking
gaps.description: When two values have the same vote count, max() picks arbitrarily (line 129). No deterministic tie-breaking.
gaps.impact: Non-deterministic consensus results
gaps.recommendation: Add deterministic tie-breaking (e.g., lexicographic order)

gaps.title: No vote validation
gaps.description: tally_votes() accepts any string as a valid vote. No validation that votes come from registered nodes or are well-formed.
gaps.impact: Invalid or spoofed votes can affect consensus
gaps.recommendation: Add vote validation with node authentication

gaps.title: No consensus round tracking
gaps.description: No concept of consensus rounds or sequence numbers. Cannot detect stale or out-of-order votes.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect replay attacks or stale votes
gaps.recommendation: Add consensus round tracking with sequence numbers

gaps.title: No auction-based allocation
gaps.description: Auction-based algorithms (e.g., Vickrey auction) are effective for distributed task allocation with self-interested agents. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot use market-based allocation strategies
gaps.recommendation: Implement auction-based task allocation

gaps.title: No contract net protocol
gaps.description: Contract Net Protocol (CNP) is a standard multi-agent task allocation protocol where agents bid on tasks. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot use CNP for distributed task allocation
gaps.recommendation: Implement Contract Net Protocol with bidding and awarding

gaps.title: No Hungarian for rectangular matrices
gaps.description: Hungarian algorithm falls back to greedy for non-square matrices (line 91-93). Rectangular assignment is common (more tasks than agents or vice versa).
gaps.impact: Suboptimal allocation for rectangular cost matrices
gaps.recommendation: Implement rectangular Hungarian algorithm

gaps.title: No market-based allocation
gaps.description: Market-based mechanisms (e.g., task markets with pricing) can achieve efficient allocation. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot use market-based allocation strategies
gaps.recommendation: Add market-based task allocation with pricing

gaps.title: No task dependencies
gaps.description: Tasks cannot depend on other tasks. Cannot model precedence constraints. No dependency graph.
gaps.impact: Cannot model workflows with ordering constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task dependency graph with topological ordering

gaps.title: No task priorities
gaps.description: Tasks have no priority. All tasks are treated equally. No priority field in AllocationInstance.
gaps.impact: Cannot prioritize critical tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add task priority field and priority-aware allocation

gaps.title: No task deadlines
gaps.description: Tasks have no deadlines. Cannot ensure time-critical tasks are assigned to agents that can complete them in time.
gaps.impact: Cannot guarantee task completion within time constraints
gaps.recommendation: Add task deadlines and deadline-aware allocation

gaps.title: No resource constraints
gaps.description: Agents have no resource limits (battery, payload, fuel). Tasks have no resource requirements. Cost matrix only captures a single scalar cost.
gaps.impact: Can over-assign tasks beyond agent capacity
gaps.recommendation: Add resource model with capacity constraints

gaps.title: No time windows
gaps.description: Tasks cannot have time windows (earliest start, latest completion). No temporal constraints.
gaps.impact: Cannot model time-constrained operations
gaps.recommendation: Add time window constraints to tasks

gaps.title: No multi-objective optimization
gaps.description: Only minimizes total cost. Cannot optimize for multiple objectives (cost, time, energy, fairness).
gaps.impact: Cannot balance competing objectives
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-objective optimization (e.g., weighted sum, Pareto frontier)

gaps.title: No dynamic allocation
gaps.description: Allocation is static. Cannot reallocate when new tasks arrive or agents fail. No incremental update mechanism.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing conditions
gaps.recommendation: Add dynamic reallocation with incremental updates

gaps.title: No online allocation
gaps.description: No support for online allocation where tasks arrive over time. All tasks must be known upfront.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle streaming task arrivals
gaps.recommendation: Add online allocation with competitive ratio guarantees

gaps.title: No fault tolerance
gaps.description: No mechanism to handle agent failures during allocation. If an agent fails after allocation, tasks are lost. No reassignment logic.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from agent failures during execution
gaps.recommendation: Add fault-tolerant allocation with task reassignment

gaps.title: No scalability limits
gaps.description: Hungarian algorithm is O(n^3). No approximation algorithms for large-scale problems. No performance benchmarks.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation for large numbers of agents/tasks
gaps.recommendation: Add approximation algorithms for large-scale allocation

gaps.title: No unassigned task reporting
gaps.description: AllocationResult has unassigned_tasks field (line 37) but it's never populated. Greedy always assigns all tasks to some agent even if no agent is suitable.
gaps.impact: Cannot identify tasks that couldn't be assigned
gaps.recommendation: Populate unassigned_tasks when no suitable agent exists

gaps.title: No cost matrix validation
gaps.description: No validation for negative costs, NaN, or infinite values in cost matrix. The __post_init__ (line 20-27) only checks dimensions.
gaps.impact: Invalid cost values can produce incorrect allocations
gaps.recommendation: Add cost matrix validation for negative, NaN, and infinite values

gaps.title: No agent capability constraints
gaps.description: The allocator only considers cost, not agent capabilities. An agent can be assigned a task it cannot perform if the cost is low. No capability matching.
gaps.impact: Can assign tasks to incapable agents
gaps.recommendation: Add agent capability constraints to the allocation problem

gaps.title: No allocation fairness metric
gaps.description: No measure of allocation fairness. The greedy algorithm can produce highly unbalanced allocations where one agent gets most tasks.
gaps.impact: Cannot evaluate or optimize for fair task distribution
gaps.recommendation: Add fairness metrics (e.g., Jain's fairness index, max-min fairness)

gaps.title: No Bully algorithm for leader election
gaps.description: LeaderElection uses a simple first-candidate approach (line 165: self._leader = self._candidates[0]). This is not a real leader election algorithm. No failure detection or automatic re-election.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle leader failure automatically; no distributed election
gaps.recommendation: Implement Bully algorithm or Raft-based election for proper leader election

gaps.title: No Raft consensus for leader election
gaps.description: Raft is a well-known consensus algorithm for leader election and log replication. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot use proven leader election protocol
gaps.recommendation: Implement Raft for leader election and log replication

gaps.title: No heartbeat integration
gaps.description: LeaderElection has no heartbeat mechanism. The leader is elected once and never checked for liveness. If the leader fails, no re-election is triggered automatically.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect leader failure or trigger automatic re-election
gaps.recommendation: Add heartbeat monitoring for leader liveness with automatic re-election

gaps.title: No split-brain prevention
gaps.description: No mechanism to prevent split-brain scenarios where two leaders are elected simultaneously. No fencing tokens or epoch numbers.
gaps.impact: Potential for dual leaders in network partition scenarios
gaps.recommendation: Add fencing tokens and epoch numbers to prevent split-brain

gaps.title: No task reassignment validation
gaps.description: reassign_failed_agent() (line 69-94) reassigns tasks but does not validate that the new agent is still active or capable. The _find_replacement() checks capabilities but not current load or health.
gaps.impact: Can reassign tasks to overloaded or failing agents
gaps.recommendation: Add validation for replacement agent health and capacity

gaps.title: No reassignment rollback
gaps.description: If a reassignment fails (e.g., new agent also fails), there is no rollback mechanism. Tasks are left in an inconsistent state.
gaps.impact: Cannot recover from cascading failures during reassignment
gaps.recommendation: Add reassignment transaction with rollback capability

gaps.title: No agent health tracking
gaps.description: AgentInfo has is_active boolean but no health score, error count, or degradation tracking. Binary active/failed is insufficient.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect gradual agent degradation
gaps.recommendation: Add health scoring with error tracking and degradation detection

gaps.title: No leader election timeout
gaps.description: elect_leader() returns immediately with no timeout or retry. If the election process fails, there is no recovery.
gaps.impact: Election can fail silently with no recovery
gaps.recommendation: Add election timeout with automatic retry

gaps.title: No candidate priority
gaps.description: All candidates have equal priority. No way to prefer certain agents as leaders (e.g., more capable agents).
gaps.impact: Cannot elect the most suitable leader
gaps.recommendation: Add candidate priority or weight for leader election

gaps.title: No distributed fault tolerance
gaps.description: All fault tolerance state is in-memory in Python dicts. No distributed state sharing. Cannot handle coordinator failure.
gaps.impact: Single point of failure; cannot survive coordinator crash
gaps.recommendation: Add distributed state sharing with coordinator replication

gaps.title: No ORCA (Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance)
gaps.description: ORCA is the standard algorithm for multi-agent collision avoidance with reciprocal velocity obstacles. Current implementation uses simple repulsive forces which can cause oscillations.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal avoidance maneuvers; potential for oscillations
gaps.recommendation: Implement ORCA for optimal reciprocal collision avoidance

gaps.title: No velocity obstacles
gaps.description: No velocity obstacle concept. The current implementation only considers positions, not velocities. Cannot predict future collisions.
gaps.impact: Cannot predict or prevent future collisions based on velocity
gaps.recommendation: Add velocity obstacle computation for predictive collision avoidance

gaps.title: No potential fields method
gaps.description: Potential fields are a common method for collision avoidance with attractive and repulsive forces. Not implemented.
gaps.impact: Cannot use potential field-based navigation
gaps.recommendation: Add potential fields method for goal-directed collision avoidance

gaps.title: No static obstacle avoidance
gaps.description: CollisionAvoidance only handles agent-agent collisions. No support for avoiding static obstacles (trees, buildings, rocks).
gaps.impact: Cannot avoid static obstacles in the environment
gaps.recommendation: Add static obstacle avoidance with obstacle representation

gaps.title: No deadlock detection
gaps.description: No mechanism to detect or resolve deadlocks where agents block each other in a cycle. The repulsive force approach can cause deadlocks in narrow passages.
gaps.impact: Agents can deadlock in confined spaces
gaps.recommendation: Add deadlock detection with random perturbation or priority-based resolution

gaps.title: No agent size/radius modeling
gaps.description: All agents are treated as points with a single safety radius. No modeling of different agent sizes or shapes.
gaps.impact: Cannot handle heterogeneous agent sizes
gaps.recommendation: Add per-agent safety radius and size modeling

gaps.title: No 3D collision avoidance
gaps.description: Only 2D positions are supported. Drones operate in 3D space and need altitude separation.
gaps.impact: Cannot prevent collisions in 3D space
gaps.recommendation: Add 3D position and collision avoidance for aerial agents

gaps.title: No collision prediction horizon
gaps.description: Collision detection is instantaneous. No prediction of future collisions based on current velocities. The compute_avoidance_velocity() only considers current positions.
gaps.impact: Cannot prevent collisions before they happen
gaps.recommendation: Add time-to-collision prediction with configurable prediction horizon

gaps.title: No spatial partitioning for collision detection
gaps.description: detect_collisions() (line 101-119) uses O(n²) pairwise comparison. For large swarms, this is slow. No spatial indexing.
gaps.impact: Performance degradation with many agents
gaps.recommendation: Add spatial partitioning (grid, quadtree) for efficient collision detection

gaps.title: No avoidance velocity clamping
gaps.description: The avoidance velocity is not clamped to max_avoidance_speed when multiple agents are nearby. The sum of avoidance velocities can exceed the maximum speed.
gaps.impact: Agents can exceed maximum speed when avoiding multiple agents
gaps.recommendation: Add velocity clamping to ensure max_avoidance_speed is not exceeded

gaps.title: No agent acceleration limits
gaps.description: No modeling of agent acceleration or deceleration limits. Avoidance velocities are applied instantaneously.
gaps.impact: Unrealistic instantaneous velocity changes
gaps.recommendation: Add acceleration limits for realistic agent dynamics

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No integration between modules
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The seven modules (coverage, obstacles, swarm, consensus, task_allocation, fault_tolerance, collision_avoidance) are completely independent. No module imports or uses any other module. There is no top-level orchestrator.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot build a complete multi-agent agricultural planning system
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create a top-level orchestrator that integrates all modules into a cohesive planning pipeline

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No common data model
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module has its own data classes with no shared abstractions. Agent, Task, Position, etc. are defined differently in each module. No common representation of agents, tasks, fields, or paths.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot pass data between modules without adaptation
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create shared data model with common types for Agent, Task, Position, Field, etc.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No configuration management
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No centralized configuration for module parameters. Each module has hardcoded defaults (e.g., heartbeat_timeout=30.0, safety_radius=2.0, max_avoidance_speed=1.0).
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot configure modules for different scenarios
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add centralized configuration with per-module settings

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No logging standardization
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module uses its own logging format. No correlation IDs or request tracing across modules. All use Python's logging module with different formats.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add standardized logging with correlation IDs

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No error handling strategy
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Each module has its own error handling. No common error types or recovery strategies. Some modules raise ValueError, others return None.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add common error types and recovery strategies

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No testing integration
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Tests are per-module with no integration tests. No end-to-end test of the full pipeline. No test that verifies modules work together.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add integration tests for the full planning pipeline

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No API/interface definition
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No public API or interface definition for the modules. Each module is used directly. No abstract base classes or protocols.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot swap implementations or add new algorithms easily
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Define abstract interfaces for each module

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No documentation
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No documentation on how to use the modules together or how they relate to each other. No architecture diagrams or module interaction documentation.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Difficult for developers to understand the system
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add architecture documentation with module interaction diagrams

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No shared agent identity
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Agent identity is represented differently across modules: Agent dataclass in swarm.py, AgentInfo in fault_tolerance.py, string IDs in task_allocation.py, string IDs in collision_avoidance.py. No unified agent identity.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot track an agent across modules
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create shared Agent identity that is used consistently across all modules

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No shared task identity
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Task identity is represented differently: Task dataclass in swarm.py, TaskInfo in fault_tolerance.py, string IDs in task_allocation.py. No unified task identity or state machine.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot track task state across modules
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Create shared Task identity with unified state machine

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No event bus integration
cross_cutting_gaps.description: The event_bus module exists in src/integration/ but is not used by any multi-agent or path planning module. No event-driven communication between modules.
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Integrate event bus for inter-module communication

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No simulation environment
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No simulation environment to test the full multi-agent system. No way to simulate agent movements, task execution, and failures in a controlled environment.
cross_cutting_gaps.impact: Cannot validate system behavior before deployment
cross_cutting_gaps.recommendation: Add simulation environment for end-to-end testing
